title: Commissioner of Wealth Tax v. Chander Sen

content.caseIdentity: Commissioner of Wealth Tax v. Chander Sen, (1986) 3 SCC 567
content.facts: The Supreme Court considered a dispute requiring interpretation of the governing family-law provision or closely connected statutory rule.
questionsBeforeCourt: What is the correct legal interpretation and application of the governing statutory rule?
content.ratioDecidendi: Property devolving under s. 8 is governed by the statutory succession scheme rather than automatic survivorship under old Hindu law.
content.holding: Property devolving under s. 8 is governed by the statutory succession scheme rather than automatic survivorship under old Hindu law.
